new.note: Ice-cold spicy ginger beer with fresh ginger coins and lime, in frosted glasses for the tarring crew.
new.how: Ice-cold ginger beer with fresh lime and thin coins of ginger, poured into frosted glasses in the sun. Put 4 glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Slice a 3cm knob of ginger into thin coins and cut 2 limes into wedges. Fill each glass with 330ml cold ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins.

steps.text: Put 4 glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Slice the ginger into thin coins and cut the limes into wedges.
Fill each glass with ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins.

new.note: Fresh lime and sugar blended with ice into a silvery slush, salt on the rim, liquid metal in a glass.
new.how: Fresh lime juice, sugar syrup and soda blended with ice into a frosty slush, poured into salt-rimmed glasses with a lime wheel. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt. Blend 150ml fresh lime juice, 100ml sugar syrup, 200ml soda water and 4 cups of ice for 30 seconds until smooth and slushy. Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel to each.

steps.text: Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt.
Juice 5 limes and slice the last one into wheels.
Blend the lime juice, sugar syrup, soda water and ice for 30 seconds until slushy.
Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel to each.

new.n: Green River lime soda for the parade
new.note: Chicago's bright green lime soda over ice with a lime wedge, poured on St Patrick's Day.
new.how: Chicago's own bright green lime soda poured over ice with a squeeze of lime. Chill 4 bottles of Green River or another lime soda. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour the soda over and push a lime wedge onto each rim.
shop: 4 x 355ml bottles Green River or lime soda@Drinks

ingredients.item: bottles Green River or lime soda (355 ml each), cold

steps.text: Pour the lime soda over and push a lime wedge onto each rim.

new.n: Logan's maple root beer on the rocks
new.note: Root beer stirred with Canadian maple syrup over one big ice cube, a flamed orange twist.
new.how: Cold root beer stirred with a little Canadian maple syrup over one big ice cube, finished with an orange twist. Put one large ice cube in each of 4 heavy tumblers. Stir 1 tsp maple syrup into each, pour over 250ml cold root beer and stir once. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.

steps.text: Put one large ice cube in each of 4 heavy tumblers.
Stir in the maple syrup, pour over the root beer and stir once.
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.
